categories.lexical: NECESSARY: recognizes or transforms a regular-language token, text fragment, or output format.
categories.composition: NECESSARY: constructs a runtime pattern from other patterns or caller search input.
categories.code: CANDIDATE: extracts programming-language structure. Review against the available AST parser.
categories.scanner: CANDIDATE: a named scanner combines iteration with string slicing. Review its input grammar.
categories.shell: NECESSARY: a shell pattern command selects or transforms command output. Structured inputs need review.

reviews.framing: NECESSARY: locates records in mixed prose or a line protocol before a real parser validates each record.
reviews.lexical: NECESSARY: matches a token or rendered fragment; it does not claim to parse the enclosing language.
reviews.traversal: NECESSARY: traverses parsed objects, AST ranges, or byte buffers. The name-based candidate detector is conservative.
reviews.cli: NECESSARY: scans a small application-owned argument or chord vocabulary. JSON and language parsers do not implement it.
reviews.safety: NECESSARY: conservative lexical policy checks references, including forbidden text; accepting a general grammar would change that policy.
reviews.sourceGate: DEFERRED: extracts source for a contract fixture or gate. Replacing its reader changes the tested program or denominator; preserve its red fixtures in a separate semantic migration.
reviews.traceability: DEFERRED: the Node-run checker owns Lean nesting and TypeScript declaration spans. A parser cutover needs parity for theorem ownership and line ranges, beyond replacing one pattern.
reviews.frontmatter: DEFERRED: the Worker parser deliberately accepts a bounded YAML subset. Bun.YAML is unavailable in Workers; a replacement adds a portable dependency and changes accepted syntax.
reviews.html: DEFERRED: conversion is synchronous and lossy. HTMLRewriter is asynchronous; a full parser changes this API and its callers. No runtime dependency is added for this inventory.
reviews.xml: DEFERRED: XML field extraction needs a namespace-aware parser to be a full replacement. A local regex rewrite would keep the same defect class.
reviews.daemon: DEFERRED: Bun.Transpiler.scan returned no require calls in the measured fixture. The owned daemon uses literal sibling requires; a parser replacement needs a different bundled API.
reviews.handbook: DEFERRED: the handbook indexes a flat scaffold and its bridge references. A complete AST replacement must preserve notes and declaration ownership; this inventory records the limitation.
reviews.schema: DEFERRED: reads a restricted DDL corpus without executing it. Replacing it with SQLite changes validation and side effects; preserve the schema gate contract first.
reviews.protected: DEFERRED: layergate and devbox are explicit non-goals. The inventory includes their candidates without changing their checks.
